pre_consolidation_head.label: target tip immediately before this consolidation commit; parent of the consolidated head

authorization_boundary: No row authorizes production vocabulary or tokenizer replacement, PRE500M, 250M, 500M, cognition, AGI, or recursive self-improvement. All such claims remain false.

state_definitions.LOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE: executed evidence constrains the choice; changing it requires new evidence that reverses the specific result
state_definitions.DEFAULT_BASELINE: no evidence discriminates; choose the simplest known-good option and do not defend it as optimal
state_definitions.PROVISIONAL: evidence supports a working choice whose scope is explicitly limited; revisit at defined milestones
state_definitions.BLOCKED_ON_EXPERIMENT: a specific unresolved experiment decides this; changing it before that evidence is UNJUSTIFIED
state_definitions.REJECTED: executed evidence contradicts the option for the stated scope
state_definitions.UNJUSTIFIED: no evidence and no baseline argument; must not be built

decisions.decision: dense causal decoder-only Transformer
decisions.rationale: simplest sufficient baseline; no isolated bottleneck implicates architecture; B01
decisions.would_change_if: an isolated formation/retention bottleneck that a specific architecture mechanism resolves under matched compute

decisions.decision: ~250M (26L x 896w) V5-A candidate; 500M campaign deferred
decisions.rationale: constructs and trains at canary scale; scale-vs-formation remains untested and CS-TRANSFER-001 is development-scale only; T1-series 2.3x null is confounded
decisions.would_change_if: a clean natural-language/larger-scale transfer result changes the formation constraint; no scale authorization follows from current evidence

decisions.decision: 26 layers
decisions.rationale: residual scaling keeps signal propagation healthy at 26L; no depth ablation at learning scale
decisions.would_change_if: depth-sweep evidence at learning scale

decisions.rationale: paired with AD02/AD03; no isolated evidence
decisions.would_change_if: width-sweep evidence at learning scale

decisions.rationale: convention; never tested here
decisions.would_change_if: n/a (keep default)

decisions.decision: full causal attention every layer; GQA 2:1 (14 Q / 7 KV), head dim 64
decisions.rationale: GQA repeat-KV equivalence verified; native GQA kernel constraint recorded on Windows stack
decisions.would_change_if: n/a (keep default)

decisions.decision: affine per-head RMS QK norm
decisions.rationale: logit-RMS invariance to Q/K scale stress (<=1.0001 vs 256x unnormalized), frozen D-025; mechanism prior, no cognition claim
decisions.would_change_if: a no-QK ablation matching learning outcomes at scale

decisions.decision: residual-output init Normal(0, 0.02/sqrt(2L))
decisions.rationale: residual growth ratio 0.12-0.23 vs unscaled, frozen D-024
decisions.would_change_if: signal-propagation failure at new depth

decisions.decision: RoPE base 10,000; native context 4,096
decisions.rationale: conformance verified; 4,096 not learning-validated
decisions.would_change_if: context-length learning evidence

decisions.decision: pre-RMSNorm + final RMSNorm
decisions.rationale: convention
decisions.would_change_if: n/a

decisions.decision: no linear bias, dropout 0
decisions.rationale: convention
decisions.would_change_if: n/a

decisions.decision: byte-level BPE with byte fallback, no destructive normalization
decisions.rationale: compression/params planning prior; CS-TRANSFER-001 used a controlled common-token surface and does not establish natural-language transfer; capability questions remain open
decisions.would_change_if: a clean natural-language transfer study changes the representation constraint; no production tokenizer change is authorized

decisions.decision: 24,576 remains the conservative frozen default
decisions.rationale: R1C and CS-TRANSFER-001 are complete: inactive masking is not sufficient and physical V4096 is not a robust remedy. Neither result proves V24576 optimality; tied-row geometry, initialization, optimizer/weight-decay/denominator interactions, and natural-language/scale transfer remain open.
decisions.would_change_if: a resolved geometry/WD interaction plus clean natural-language/larger-scale transfer evidence supports a bounded alternative; current evidence does not authorize a production vocabulary change

decisions.decision: default BPE number segmentation
decisions.rationale: number atomization remains a correlated factor; R1C and CS-TRANSFER-001 are completed narrow results and do not isolate a production segmentation choice
decisions.would_change_if: a clean representation/segmentation isolation and natural-language transfer result changes the decision; no production change follows now

decisions.decision: tied weights currently; no mechanism lock
decisions.rationale: the class-space effect moves tied embedding and output jointly; R1C/CS leave tied-row geometry, parameterization/initialization, and optimizer/weight-decay/denominator interactions open; S5 is floor-limited and cannot exonerate a mechanism. ROLE-TRANSFER-001 is a preregistered but unexecuted and blocked design, not positive evidence.
decisions.would_change_if: the preregistered ROLE-TRANSFER-001 validity gates pass away from floor/ceiling and its role-specific contrast resolves the interaction under matched preclip norms

decisions.decision: do not use as the production remedy
decisions.rationale: R1C found SOFTMAX_COMPETITION_NOT_SUFFICIENT and CS-TRANSFER-001 found physical V4096 is not a robust remedy. This rejects masked/intermediate softmax as a production remedy without claiming V24576 optimality.
decisions.would_change_if: new preregistered physical-geometry and optimizer evidence, not another mask-only proxy, demonstrates a bounded production-safe alternative

decisions.decision: BF16 compute, FP32 master params + FP32 Adam moments, FP32 logits/loss/clip reductions
decisions.rationale: parity verified (rel err 0.000118); native BF16 moments violate clip invariant (D-026/D-028); R1C clip-tolerance derivation reinforces FP32 reduction care
decisions.would_change_if: long-horizon parity failure

decisions.decision: AdamW beta (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, wd 0.1 on ndim>=2, no decay on norms/QK scales
decisions.rationale: production contract; alternatives remain untested at learning scale
decisions.would_change_if: matched optimizer comparison at learning scale

decisions.decision: phase-dependent micro law: HIGH for acquisition/recovery, LOW/CAP1X or support-replay for retention
decisions.rationale: replicated micro-T2 law with explicit boundaries; no universal scheduler exists; production WSD untouched
decisions.would_change_if: scale-transfer evidence changes the regime-specific lever

decisions.decision: token-indexed WSD 0->3e-4/50M, decay to 3e-5/5B
decisions.rationale: unit-tested, never executed end-to-end; all executed runs used bounded warmup
decisions.would_change_if: first production-schedule execution after all fail-closed gates

decisions.decision: global L2 clip 1.0 with post-clip certification tolerance 1e-4
decisions.rationale: certified invariant; float32 reduction-order derivation documented in the R1C repair
decisions.would_change_if: n/a

decisions.decision: treatment-exact sparse replay as external protection; dose NOT universal; internalization NOT justified
decisions.rationale: both-levers result; 1/64 and 1/16 protected in screens only; this-regime replay failed with weak provenance
decisions.would_change_if: dose-response evidence or mechanism dissection

decisions.decision: no controller in production
decisions.rationale: V3.1 was CONTROLLER_NOT_SUPPORTED; the V4 Guardian result is transcribed without its raw bundle; ARK-020 readiness is DO_NOT_RUN with confirmed resume/identity defects. No controller is authorized.
decisions.would_change_if: the raw Guardian bundle passes byte audit and a separately qualified ARK-020 run demonstrates efficiency over static replay without task-ID leakage

decisions.decision: causal CE over eligible targets, answer+EOS supervised, label smoothing 0/z-loss 0, query-swap and trace lambdas 0
decisions.rationale: EOS contract demonstrated cross-program; margin objective falsified; auxiliary pressures remain unproven
decisions.would_change_if: a qualified-substrate experiment shows auxiliary-lambda transfer

decisions.decision: 65/20/15 with nine cognition families
decisions.rationale: implementation decision, never measured; zero-cognition control missing
decisions.would_change_if: regenerated corpus screens and E3 mixture screens execute

decisions.decision: do not stop at train saturation; budget past the delayed-generalization region
decisions.rationale: delayed transition replicated; M99 does not predict G90
decisions.would_change_if: a substrate where saturation coincides with lift-off

decisions.decision: candidate-free generation primary; orthogonal invariance axes; sealed firewall; robust-min reporting; no aggregate-only promotion
decisions.rationale: calibrated scorers fail bias screens; canonical accuracy hides narrowing; shortcut/leakage attacks mandatory and T1D is not ready
decisions.would_change_if: a certified scoring mode reopens assisted comparison as secondary

decisions.decision: executable-truth generators with calibrated + attack screens; current tiered arithmetic surface retired
decisions.rationale: surface regeneration must pass contamination, shortcut, leakage, and sealed-fixture screens before feeding any campaign
decisions.would_change_if: regenerated corpus and evaluation surfaces pass the full audit

decisions.decision: runtime controller, verifier, memory, tools stay OUTSIDE the Core
decisions.rationale: separation is the strongest structural asset; no evidence for internalization
decisions.would_change_if: causal credit evidence shows an internal mechanism beats the external loop

decisions.component: learned internal memory / MoE / SSM / latent-thought modules
decisions.decision: none
decisions.rationale: no bottleneck evidence demands them; adding them destroys attribution
decisions.would_change_if: an isolated bottleneck that one mechanism resolves under matched compute

decisions.decision: fail-closed content-addressed promotion with immutable checkpoints + sealed consumption
decisions.rationale: canaries prove restore equals uninterrupted, tamper rejection, and vacuous-promotion elimination
decisions.would_change_if: n/a

decisions.decision: none
decisions.rationale: X1 invalidated; no qualified subject; basis qualification is the gate
decisions.would_change_if: qualified substrate plus a basis beating constant baselines prospectively

decisions.decision: no architecture promotion; retain TIE-role as a blocked provisional research branch
decisions.rationale: S5 formal NULLs are floor-limited, while the later frontier snapshot has only 2/24 arms and no sealed, final, or checkpoint payload. Neither record can lock or exonerate a mechanism.
decisions.would_change_if: the multi-seed control-capability/checkpoint-metric preflight leaves the floor and a complete sealed TIE-role result supports a bounded mechanism
